title: PACK-15 credential replay event payload (v1)
description: Produced by epd2_credential_service.voting_credential_events.build_replay_event. Used by voting_credential.replay_rejected. It deliberately omits any attribution: a replay carries no holder, no credential reference and no exact detection timestamp - only the context, the reason code and the coarsened timing_class - because none of the omitted facts is knowable on the voting side without reconstructing the link ADR-093 forbids.
